Chapter 1207 - 22: A Millennium Passes (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 1207: Chapter 22: A Millennium Passes (Subscription Requested)

"How should we use the golden mist?"

Immediately, the eyes of the surrounding Peak Venerables lit up.

During the time spent in this treasure land, all the Peak Venerables have been primarily focused on searching for the core heavenly pillar.

But during this period, they have more or less acquired some golden mist.

This golden mist is connected with the aura of the entire treasure land, clearly a rare treasure nurtured by it.

As a newly formed treasure land, the rare treasures it nurtures have never appeared in the six Ancient Countries, so naturally, no one knows their effects and uses. They can only explore slowly.

"That golden mist."

Lin Yuan was also very concerned, as his external cosmos could probe every detail within a range of over ten billion miles, and he had collected quite a bit of the golden mist.

"The golden mist contains the Origin Power of time. Do not contact it with your soul or mind, otherwise, you may be forced into a time cycle."

Red Flame Venerable warned seriously.

The Peak Venerables have perfected their realms, and with a single thought, they can attempt to break through to the Thirteenth Stage, bringing about the time cycle.

However, the Peak Venerables have always suppressed the idea of breaking through to the Thirteenth Stage, so the time cycle hasn’t descended upon them.

Once they contact the golden mist with the mind’s will, no matter how much they suppress it, they will be forced to break through to the Thirteenth Stage.

"Time cycle?"

Red Lotus Venerable and the other Peak Venerables were filled with fear.

Most of the Peak Venerables will eventually attempt to break through to the Thirteenth Stage Ancestor Realm, but that’s the plan when they have no further progress to make.

As for now? Many Peak Venerables still intend to wait a bit longer.

"Entering the time cycle prematurely?"

Listening on the side, Lin Yuan was slightly moved.

Other Peak Venerables, when contacting the golden mist with their will, would fall into a time cycle because their realms are already perfected.

But Lin Yuan?

His true realm was still at the Dominator Stage, far from the perfect Chaos Realm necessary to break through to the Thirteenth Stage.

If Lin Yuan contacts the golden mist with his will, it’s estimated he wouldn’t bring about a time cycle since his realm hasn’t reached that point.

"Thankfully, I didn’t try it back then."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, even though he doesn’t need to worry about entering a time cycle prematurely, who knows if there are other hidden risks besides this one?

"As for how to use the golden mist? So far, slowly absorbing it with the physical body is best."

"The golden mist will gradually transform the physical body, forming a certain time-based physique."

Red Flame Venerable said.

This conclusion was reached after many attempts by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

They even had a Venerable enter a time cycle prematurely for this reason.

"Slowly absorbing with the physical body? To transform into a time-based physique?"

Many Peak Venerables seemed thoughtful, as this effect was similar to that of the Infinite Crystal.

However, the Infinite Divine Body transformed by the Infinite Crystal focuses on inclusiveness, capable of accommodating any other physique, whereas the physique transformed by the golden mist is yet unknown in its effects.

Next.

Red Flame Venerable gave a few more reminders and then remained silent.

"I’ll wait a bit longer and refrain from absorbing the golden mist for now."

After thinking about it, Lin Yuan decided not to immediately absorb the golden mist with his body.

After all, the golden mist he collected remains there. He can choose to absorb it at any time. It’s better to wait until other Peak Venerables try it and see the results to determine how to use it correctly.

And according to Red Flame Venerable, the golden mist can only be slowly absorbed by the physical body, as for completely transforming into the corresponding physique? No one knows how much golden mist is needed.

...

Chaos Void.

Galaxy Chaos Continent.

Since the Great Saint of the Galaxy established the Chaos Continent, powerful figures from thousands, tens of thousands, and hundreds of thousands of Void Domains in the surrounding area have been arriving here one after another.

This is very normal; the Chaos Great Saint’s fame in the Chaos Void attracts numerous Chaos Realm venerable beings, all with different intentions.

Some purely wish to witness this Chaos Great Saint.

Some plan to follow this Chaos Great Saint, and so on.

Others see the gathering of numerous venerable beings at the Galaxy Chaos Continent and knowing they can’t attract the attention of the Great Saint of the Galaxy, plan to make good relationships with these Venerable Beings.

"That is the Chaos Continent established by the Great Saint of the Galaxy."

In a silver spaceship, a gray-haired old man looked at the distant majestic continent and said to the young men and women beside him.

"The Great Saint of the Galaxy?"

These young men and women also looked at the distant Galaxy Chaos Continent: "Sect Master, what is special about this Great Saint of the Galaxy? Why do you intend to move the sect here?"

The gray-haired old man is a Chaos Realm peak Venerable, who also once opened a Chaos Continent, eventually establishing an influential legacy.

The gray-haired old man had followed several Chaos Great Saints but ultimately left them all. He now plans to bring the sect’s elite to reside permanently on the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

"The Great Saint of the Galaxy is not an ordinary Chaos Great Saint."

The gray-haired old man said with a smile: "In that Postnatal Universe, the Great Saint of the Galaxy left Black Light Great Saint and Wild Barbarian Great Saint far behind with an overwhelming advantage. Even if not matching the Invincible Great Saints, he is not far behind."

"Not far behind the Invincible Great Saints?"

The young men and women were shocked. Even the same information leads to different conclusions when seen by different levels of strong individuals.

The gray-haired old man had evidently deduced the true strength limit of the Great Saint of the Galaxy from the intelligence information.

...

In a distant time and space.

Three figures stood silently.

The mere presence of these three figures caused the surrounding Chaos Rule to retreat.

"That Galaxy Great Saint, being the only one to walk out alive from the Xuanhuang Universe in a complete Chaos Realm, might obtain some opportunities left by Xuanhuang."

The leading figure spoke.

All three figures were Invincible Great Saints, all incredibly ancient, aware of the existence of Xuanhuang.

Xuanhuang had forcibly broken free from the time cycle, completely annihilating five Invincible Great Saints, causing many hidden Invincible Great Saints to tremble.

That was Invincible Great Saints.

In the history of the Chaos Void, battles between Invincible Great Saints sometimes occurred, where one would fall.

Yet, this fall was merely the demise of the main battle body, not the end of the Invincible Great Saint itself.

To completely annihilate an Invincible Great Saint, destroying all forms and erasing all means of survival, was incredibly difficult, something even Invincible Great Saints couldn’t achieve.

"This Chaos Continent requires at least Ninth Realm insights in space-time to be established." At this moment, the Invincible Great Saint on the right spoke.

"Ninth Realm insights into space-time? Even if it’s not an Invincible Great Saint, we cannot do anything to them."

The Invincible Great Saint on the right said.

An entity at the Chaos Great Saint level reaching Ninth Realm insights into space-time is exceedingly rare, rarer than Invincible Great Saints.

Even such a Chaos Great Saint, though not yet a match for Invincible Great Saints, could easily retreat unscathed.

"Indeed."

The last Invincible Great Saint shook his head.

The three Invincible Great Saints originally intended to find the Galaxy Great Saint and inquire about the happenings within the Xuanhuang Universe.

But now it seems.

There is no need.

Unable to do anything to the opponent, even if they were to inquire, they wouldn’t get the truth.

"Forget it."

"Best not to make enemies."

The leading Invincible Great Saint pondered carefully and made a decision in his heart.

If the Galaxy Great Saint were just an ordinary Chaos Great Saint, they could naturally handle it as they wished.

But now?

The Galaxy Great Saint already had the confidence to oppose them, and the three Invincible Great Saints were unwilling to make enemies without understanding what opportunities the Galaxy Great Saint might have obtained from Xuanhuang.

If they speculated wrongly and the Galaxy Great Saint had not obtained much opportunity, they would gain another enemy.

Invincible Great Saints are extremely cautious when dealing with equally powerful beings, just like Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint, who waited until Xuanhuang attempted to break through the Thirteenth Level before retaliating heavily against the Profound Xuanhuang lineage.

"Let’s go."

The three Invincible Great Saints took one last look at the distant Chaos Continent and vanished.

...

"They left?"

Deep within the Galaxy Chaos Continent, Lin Yuan glanced in the direction the three Invincible Great Saints disappeared.

These Chaos Great Saints only knew that Lin Yuan’s space-time insights had reached the Ninth Realm, but were unaware of Lin Yuan’s current true combat strength, which could be considered strong even among Invincible Great Saints.

With Lin Yuan’s perception, he detected the approaching three Invincible Great Saints instantly.

"My current strength has been surpassed by the true form in the Origin Source World."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, as the true form in the Origin Source World had formed a Fierce Sun Great Cycle within, first surpassing the true form in the Chaos Void.

There was no way around it; the true form in the Origin Source World had a complete Thirteenth Level time life inheritance and the integration of Chaos Void Thirteenth Level inheritance.

Meanwhile, the true form in the Chaos Void couldn’t form the Seed of the Fierce Sun, leading to a lack of corresponding enhancement.

"Once ’Infinite Void’ is mastered to the third level, the gap between the two true forms may be narrowed or even erased."

Lin Yuan contemplated.

The Thirteenth Level inheritance ’Infinite Void’ would significantly enhance both the Chaos Void and Origin Source World true forms once mastered to the third level.

However, the extent of enhancement would naturally be greater for the true form in the Chaos Void.

After all, the Chaos Void’s true form had a cosmic foundation surpassing that of the Origin Source World true form.

Different starting points in the internal universe lead to different enhancements once ’Infinite Void’ is mastered to the third level.

"Or stepping into the Chaos Realm might work."

The differing foundational depths in their internal worlds result in varying enhancement upon entering the Chaos Realm.

Clearly, the true form in the Chaos Void stands to gain more than the true form in the Origin Source World.

"I’ll take it slow; there is still much for me to improve."

Compared to other Great Saint Venerables who have reached their limits, Lin Yuan was still far from his own limit.

Besides mastering ’Infinite Void’ and stepping into the Chaos Realm, evolving the Chaos Taiji Power could also greatly enhance Lin Yuan.

In addition, many supreme Secret Techniques passed down by the ancestor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, also known as Thirteenth Level inheritance, were yet to be practiced by Lin Yuan.

And so.

Time passed slowly.

A millennium was gone in the blink of an eye.
